description: Source code demonstrating usage of miniz.c's low-level compression and decompression APIs (tdefl_compress and tinfl_inflate) for file-to-file compression/decompression. Includes implementation of main() handling file I/O, compression levels, and mode selection.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Performs file compression or decompression based on command-line arguments, utilizing miniz's low-level APIs.
